summary: Omori entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Omori
entries.definitive_edition: Console release with added content, platform availability verified

emulation.notes: Use native console/PC route; PC route is useful for capture comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native console build with added content

primary.platform: Nintendo Switch / PlayStation 4 / Xbox console build
primary.why: The original Steam PC release is the easiest capture route, but the later console builds added content not present in the Steam version. Because Omori is a 2D RPG where fidelity differences are modest, the archive route should prioritize the more complete console build.
primary.how_to_play: Use a current Switch, PS4, or owned Xbox/Windows console-content build. Record platform, build/date, route choice, language, ending route, and whether any PC capture/mod comparison was made.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original PC route and easiest mod/capture environment
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the original 2020 PC release or PC mods.
secondary.why: The Steam PC version is not the most complete route because console-added content is absent.

entries.remaster_caveats: Avoid spoiler-heavy version notes in public-facing summaries. Record route and platform because the Xbox/Microsoft Store availability has changed over time.
